stem.text: Which statement about a light microscope is correct?

A.text: As the distance to see two points as separate points decreases, the resolution also decreases.

B.text: A bacterium $0.2\,\mu\text{m}$ in diameter will **not** be visible if the resolution is $220\,\text{nm}$.

C.text: Two membranes that are less than $300\,\text{nm}$ apart will be visible as two separate membranes if the wavelength of light is $600\,\text{nm}$.

D.text: The resolution will improve with visible light of a longer wavelength, such as red light.
